lessons.title: Array Introduction
lessons.summary: Until now, we've used variables to hold individual values. But what if a program needs to manage many values of the same type?

blocks.content: Until now, we've used variables to hold individual values. But what if a program needs to manage many values of the same type?
For example, storing the scores of 50 students in separate variables would make the program unnecessarily long.
An array provides a simpler solution. It lets us keep multiple values of the same data type together under one variable.
In this lesson, you'll learn how to:

- Create an array.
- Access values stored in an array.
- Update array elements.
Let's begin by learning how to create an array

blocks.content: Now that you've learned how to create, access, modify, and loop through arrays, it's time to put those skills together.
In this lesson, we'll solve problems such as:

- Determine the highest value stored in an array.
- Practice: Determine the lowest value.
- Build a new array using values from an existing array.
- Practice: Change every value in an array by multiplying it by 5.
These examples will help you become more comfortable with processing array data using loops.
